chapter.verse: Tua khit ciangin Tiberias Tuili gei, nungzuite' kiangah Jesu kilaak leuleu hi. A kilaakzia hih bang ahi hi.
Simon Peter, (Didymus a kici) Thomas, (Galilee gam Cana khua pan) Nathanael, Zebedee' tapate leh nungzui a dang nihte, mun khat ah om uh hi.

Simon Peter in amaute' kiangah, “Ngabeng ka va pai ding hi,” ci hi. Amaute in, “Ko zong kong pai ding uh hi,” ci hi. Amaute paikhia-in gunkuang sungah tuang uh a, ahih hangin tua zanin bangmah man lo uh hi.
Zingsang khuavak ciangin tuinawl piau tungah Jesu ding a, ahi zongin nungzuite in Jesu ahihlam thei lo uh hi.
Jesu in, “Tanote aw, ngasa na nei uh hiam?” ci hi. Amaute in, “Nei lo,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Na ngen uh gunkuang taklam pang ah khia un. Tua hileh na man ding uh hi,” ci hi. Amau zong a ngen khia uh a, ngasa tampi awk ahih manin a ngen uh kaito zolo uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu' itdeuh nungzuipa in, “Topa hi!” ci hi. Simon Peter in Topa ahihna thu a zak ciangin (nasem dingin puan a suahsa ahih manin) a puantual tungsilh liangvat pakin tui sungah diangsuk hi.
Nungzui dangte zong ngasa a dima om ngen kai-in gunkuang neu tawh hong tung uh hi. A hang pen amaute leitang tawh kigamla lua lo uh a, pi zathum kiim bek kihal uh hi.
Lei ah a tun uh ciangin meihol kicih meiphual ahi zongin, tua tunga ki-em ngasa ahi zongin, anlum ahi zongin mu uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Na ngasa matte uh kimkhat hong tawi un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin gunkuang sungah Simon Peter va pai-in ngasa gol tawh a kidim, ngasa zakhat sawmnga-le-thum a pha, a ngen uh tuinawl piau ah kaito hi. Ngasa tampi pha napi a ngen uh kikek lo hi.
Jesu in, “Hong pai unla zing an ne un,” ci hi. Nungzuite in Topa ahihlam thei uh ahih manin, “Nang kua na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong ngam kuamah om lo uh hi.
Jesu hong pai-in anlum la-in amaute pia a, tua mah bangin ngasa zong pia hi.
Hih pen misite' lakpan Jesu a kithawhkiksak khit, nungzuite' kianga a kilaak a thumveina ahi hi.

Zing an a nek khit uh ciangin Jesu in Simon Peter' kiangah, “John' tapa Simon aw, hihte' hong itzah sang'n a lianzaw-in kei nong it hiam?” ci hi. Peter in, “Kong it hi, Topa; kong it lam na thei hi,” ci hi. Jesu in, “Ka tuunote na vak in,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nihveina dong leuleu a, “John' tapa Simon aw, kei nong it hiam?” ci hi. Peter in, “Kong it hi, Topa; kong it lam na thei hi,” ci hi. Jesu in, “Ka tuute na cing in,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin a thumveina dong leuleu a, “John' tapa Simon aw, kei nong it hiam?” ci hi. “Kei nong it hiam?” ci-in thumveina dong a dot manin Peter a khasiat suak a, “Topa aw, nangmah in na khempeuh na thei hi. Nang kong it lam na thei hi,” ci hi. Jesu in, “Ka tuute na vak in.

Maantak diktak kong cihin ah na khangno hun lai-in na puante na silhtawm a, na ututna ah lam na pai hi. Ahi zongin na teek ciangin na khutte na zan ding a, midang khat in puan hong silhsakin na utlohna mun ah hong paipih ding hi,” ci hi.
(Hih bang a gen ciangin amah'n bangci sihna nam tawh Pasian pahtawi ding cih a genkhol ahi hi.) Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Jesu in Peter' kiangah, “Hong zui in,” ci hi.
Peter a kihei leh nitak an a nek lai-un Jesu' ang lamah tu-in, “Topa aw, nang hong lehhek dingpa kua ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong, Jesu' itdeuh nungzuipa, mu hi.
A muh ciangin Peter in Jesu' kiangah, “Topa aw, hih mipa' vai bangci dan hiding hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Kong pai dong amah a omsuak dingin ka deih leh zong bang phamawh sa na hi hiam? Nang na hihleh kei hong zui in,” ci hi.

Tua hangin hih nungzuipa si lo ding cih thu sanggamte lakah kigen ngeingai hi. Ahi zongin Jesu' gen pen amah si lo ding cih thu hilo a, “Kong pai dong amah a omsuak dingin ka deih leh zong bang phamawh sa na hi hiam?” cih bek ahi hi.
Tua nungzuipa pen hih thute teci a pangpa, lai tawh a gelhkhiapa hi a, ama' teci panna maan ahihlam ka thei uh hi.
Tu-in Jesu' sep thu a dang tampitak omlai hi. Tuate khempeuh a vekin lai tawh kigelh hileh tua a kigelh ding laibute leitung ah ta zolo ding ci-in ka um hi.
